hook: Netanyahu or Eisenkot? Polls can't tell
reel_hook: Israel votes, and nobody knows who wins

slides.title: Israel's too-close-to-call vote
slides.image_prompt: A ballot box on a perfectly level balance scale, two equal stacks of paper ballots on each side, soft blue and white light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Netanyahu faces ex-army chief Eisenkot in Israel's election.
WHY IT MATTERS
Turnout is the highest in decades, with no clear favourite.
FOR YOU
Exit polls come at 20:00 UTC; full results could take weeks.
slides.body: Netanyahu faces ex-army chief Eisenkot in Israel's election. Turnout is the highest in decades, with no clear favourite. Exit polls come at 20:00 UTC; full results could take weeks.

slides.title: Kyiv hit as Oleshky truce holds
slides.image_prompt: A damaged river bridge at dawn beside a quiet road lined with white aid boxes, smoke fading in a grey sky
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russia struck Kyiv overnight as a local truce began.
WHY IT MATTERS
The Oleshky ceasefire lets aid in and civilians out.
FOR YOU
New US-brokered talks are expected; watch if this truce lasts until Saturday.
slides.body: Russia struck Kyiv overnight as a local truce began. The Oleshky ceasefire lets aid in and civilians out. New US-brokered talks are expected; watch if this truce lasts until Saturday.

slides.title: Rare four-way talks in Tehran
slides.image_prompt: Four empty chairs around a round wooden table with tea glasses, a desert night sky outside the window with distant streaks of light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Iran hosted Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials in Tehran.
WHY IT MATTERS
First joint talks, as Houthi missiles target Saudi Arabia.
FOR YOU
No deal yet; Iran says talks with the three countries will continue.
slides.body: Iran hosted Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials in Tehran. First joint talks, as Houthi missiles target Saudi Arabia. No deal yet; Iran says talks with the three countries will continue.

slides.title: Claude maker files for IPO
slides.image_prompt: A brass stock exchange bell on a podium in an empty trading hall, ticker lights glowing as abstract colored streaks
slides.label: ECONOMY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Anthropic filed to list on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.
WHY IT MATTERS
Revenue hit $16.3B in six months; losses were $80.7B.
FOR YOU
Share price isn't set; reports say it could be the biggest IPO ever.

slides.title: Oxford Street goes car-free
slides.image_prompt: A wide empty London shopping street with paving stones, potted trees and benches, a red bus stop sign removed and leaning aside
slides.label: CURIOSITY
points: WHAT HAPPENED
About 1 km of London's Oxford Street is now traffic-free.
WHY IT MATTERS
No cars, buses, taxis or bikes, permanently.
FOR YOU
Visiting London? You can stroll past Selfridges and John Lewis without traffic.
slides.body: About 1 km of London's Oxford Street is now traffic-free. No cars, buses, taxis or bikes, permanently. Visiting London? You can stroll past Selfridges and John Lewis without traffic.

caption:
🗳️ Israel votes: Netanyahu vs Eisenkot, too close to call. Exit polls land when voting ends at 20:00 UTC.
🇺🇦 Russia strikes Kyiv (at least 1 killed, per Ukraine's emergency service) as a small truce starts in Oleshky.
🤝 Iran hosts Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials, while Houthi missiles target Saudi Arabia.
📈 Anthropic, maker of Claude, files for a Nasdaq IPO. Price not set yet.
🚶 Almost half of London's Oxford Street is now car-free for good.
